verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items are a fair question for an AI-driven game engine, but the evidence never documents batch or multi-item operations on game objects, assets, or other content. The closest items are the agent-setup command and skills that install for every agent at once. Those are one-time setup conveniences, not bulk operations on items, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
